subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should OpenClaw add a LINE-specific opt-in media batching setting now, or defer this issue to a broader cross-channel media coalescing design?
rationale: The remaining gap is real but solving it adds a user-facing config knob and changes LINE dispatch timing, reply-token handling, and batching semantics, which are product and compatibility choices rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Approve LINE-scoped opt-in
options.body: Implement a LINE plugin option that batches rapid downloadable media from the same account, conversation, and sender without changing shared text debounce or Telegram behavior.

options.title: Wait for cross-channel coalescing
options.body: Keep the issue open as the canonical media batching tracker until maintainers design a shared media-aware coalescer for multiple channels.

options.title: Document as unsupported for LINE
options.body: Close or narrow the issue if maintainers decide LINE time-proximity media grouping is too heuristic for the official plugin.

recommendation.title: Approve LINE-scoped opt-in
recommendation.body: Implement a LINE plugin option that batches rapid downloadable media from the same account, conversation, and sender without changing shared text debounce or Telegram behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest recent history on LINE handler ownership and already implemented the related Telegram media-group config path.
